notes.title: About the next version of the 99A main battle tank model
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, I am sorry that the last announcement used the wrong screen shot of the tank, that is our other project 99 tank model, now put the correct screen shot of the tank.

About the next version of the update time, now we still have a lot of work to do, including Bug fixes (lateral drift, jitter, volume control, etc.) , modular damage systems, new muzzle stabilization systems (steady firing on the move) , new night vision systems (able to penetrate smoke) , new AI systems, model details, scene details, interactive vegetation, destructible buildings, etc. , please be patient and if all goes well we will make a major update in 4 months to give you a better game.

We are a very small team (2 people) , in order to be able to do this game, we work more than ten hours a day, so unable to respond to each player in a timely manner in the forum, please forgive us. But we will check the forum regularly, collect the player’s comments and suggestions and improve the game, you can rest assured in the forum message, thank you!

notes.title: Next version of the plan
notes.content:
Our game has been on the shelves for a week, thanks to the support of the players.According to the forums and feedback from players, the next version of the plan is as follows :

    1.Add automatic game progress save function.
    2.Add the type of gun fired missiles.
    3.Add tactical map feature.
    4.Add vehicle-mounted four-axis drone for reconnaissance or detonation, and the area surveyed will be shown on the tactical map.
    5.Optimize and refine the plot of the story pattern to make it more compact.
    6.Optimize and improve the UI system.
    7.Optimize and improve the operation feel of the tank.
    8.Optimize and improve the physical characteristics of tanks.
    9.Improve the mode of ammunition supply.
    10.Fix some bugs in physical collisions.
    11.Fix the bug where some of the levels fail to complete the task.
    12.Fix some bugs in the keystroke definition.
    13.Fix The volume bug.
